item.name: Appointments
item.description: Book, read, reschedule and cancel appointments.

item.name:
POST /api/v1/appointments
Creates an appointment, but only if the policy allows this user to do so.

DELETE /api/v1/appointments/{appointment}
Deletes the appointment, but only if the policy allows it.

PUT /api/v1/appointments/{appointment}
Replaces the whole appointment, but only if the policy allows it.

variable.description: The ID of the appointment appointment.

item.name:
PATCH /api/v1/appointments/{appointment}
Updates only the fields that were sent, but only if the policy allows it.

variable.description: The ID of the appointment appointment.

item.name: Assistant
item.description:
The SmileSync assistant. It understands English, Filipino or both, answers from the clinic's own data,
and books, reschedules and cancels through the same slot engine as the rest of the API.

item.name: GET /api/v1/chat/history — the logged-in patient's last messages.
Authentication
item.description: Register, login, logout and refresh tokens.

request.description: Creates the account and logs the user in immediately.
The login page calls this to know whether to show the Google button.
Send the ID token ("credential") that Google's button returned.
Returns an access token. Send it as a Bearer token on every other request.

item.name:
POST /api/v1/auth/register-patient
A patient creates an account. A patient record is created with it, so they can use the assistant right away (FR-30).
GET /api/v1/auth/clinics — clinic names for the register screen.
Clinic records
item.description:
One controller for the clinic modules (services, schedules, treatments, invoices, inventory, feedback ...).
Each resource lists who may read and who may write. Every create, update and delete is written to the audit log.

item.name:
POST /api/v1/r/patient-records/{id}/restore
Brings an archived patient back into the lists (WST criterion 11: recovery).

request.description: Same roles that may archive; the audit log keeps the before and after.

item.name: Clinic workflow
item.description: Daily queue, check-in, walk-ins, invoices, reports, reminders, patient summary and OCR upload.

item.name: GET /queue?date=&dentistId= — today's patients in order of arrival or appointment time.
POST /queue/{id}/status {status} — move an appointment through its statuses.
POST /queue/{id}/followup {date} — books a follow-up at the first open slot of that day.
POST /invoices/generate {appointmentId} — builds an invoice from the treatments done (or the service price).

variable.description: The ID of the patient summary.

item.name: POST /reminders/run — the same job the schedule runs (php artisan smilesync:reminders).
POST /waitlist/{id}/confirm — the patient takes the offered slot and the appointment is created.
GET /app-settings — reminder timing, no-show threshold, offer expiry.
POST /clinics/{id}/admin {name,email,password} — SuperAdmin creates the Clinic Administrator account (FR-06).
GET /api/v1/stats — real counts for the staff dashboard, limited to the user's clinic.
GET /api/v1/stats/finance?branch_id= — sales, paid, pending and charts for the admin dashboard.
GET /api/v1/public/landing — what visitors see (no login). Published feedback becomes testimonials.

item.name: Lookups
item.description: Lists the services, dentists and branches used by the booking forms.

item.name:
GET /api/v1/lookups
Everything the front end needs to fill its dropdowns. Staff also get the patient names.
Patient Appointments
item.description: The appointments of one patient. The patient id comes from the URL.

item.name:
GET /api/v1/patients/{patient}/appointments
Lists only this patient's appointments. All AppointmentFilter parameters work here too.

variable.description: The ID of the patient patient.

item.name:
POST /api/v1/patients/{patient}/appointments
Creates an appointment for the patient named in the URL.

variable.description: The ID of the patient patient.

item.name:
DELETE /api/v1/patients/{patient}/appointments/{appointment}
Deletes the appointment. The scoped binding returns 404 if it is not this patient's appointment.

variable.description: The ID of the patient patient.

item.name:
PUT /api/v1/patients/{patient}/appointments/{appointment}
Replaces the whole appointment (staff only).

variable.description: The ID of the patient patient.

item.name: GET /api/v1/my/transactions — every payment made on the patient's own invoices.
GET /api/v1/my/notifications — built from reminders, staff replies, invoices, payments and appointment updates.

GET /api/v1/patients
Filters and sorting come from the URL (?fullName=*maria*, ?sort=-createdAt .

request.description:
..).
Add ?include=appointments to load each patient's appointments in one extra query.

Staff only. A patient must never be able to list other patients: the clinic
scope limits rows to the clinic, not to the person, so without this check a
signed-in patient could read every other patient's name, email and contact
number. Patients use the /my/* endpoints for their own record instead.

item.name:
GET /api/v1/patients/{patient}
Add ?include=appointments to load this patient's appointments.

request.description: A patient may read only their own record.

item.name: Scanned forms
item.description:
Reads a HANDWRITTEN patient form with an AI vision model and returns the patient fields.
Works with Google Gemini or Anthropic; set the matching key in .env. Settings are read
through config/ocr.php so they survive config caching in production.
Without a key the screen falls back to the basic in-browser reader.

item.name: Slots
item.description: Find the free time slots of a dentist.

item.name:
GET /api/v1/slots
Lists the free slots of one dentist on one date. The slot length comes from the service.
Staff inbox
item.description:
Chats the assistant passed to staff. Staff read the conversation and reply, and the reply
shows up inside the patient's assistant panel.

item.name: GET /api/v1/chat/replies?after=ID — the logged-in patient's staff replies.
Users
item.description: Manage clinic staff and patient login accounts.

item.name:
GET /api/v1/users
Lists every user with the filters and sorting from the URL.

POST /api/v1/users
Creates a user (needs the user:create ability).

request.description:
A clinic admin can only add users to their own clinic. Only the SuperAdmin can pick a clinic
or create another SuperAdmin. Every user except a SuperAdmin must belong to a clinic.

item.name:
PUT /api/v1/users/{user}
Replaces the whole user: every field is required (needs user:replace).

PATCH /api/v1/users/{user}
Updates only the fields that were sent (needs user:update).
Waitlist
item.description: Join the waiting list when a slot is full. A freed slot is offered to the first person waiting.

item.name:
GET /api/v1/waitlist
Staff see everyone. A patient sees only their own entries.

POST /api/v1/waitlist
Join the waiting list. A patient joins for themselves. Staff must send patientId.
